description: Free universal media downloader tray app -- yt-dlp + gallery-dl with an arcade WPF UI.
notes: GRAB installs as a portable tray app. On first launch it lives in the system tray (bottom-right).
If Windows SmartScreen warns you: click More info -> Run anyway. GRAB is unsigned (no $400/yr EV cert for a free OSS tool).
Config lives in %APPDATA%\grab-app\ by default. Drop a portable-mode.flag next to grab-app.vbs to keep everything alongside the binaries (USB stick style).
post_install: Write-Host '  GRAB installed via Scoop.' -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host '  Launch by running:  grab' -ForegroundColor Gray
Write-Host '  Or double-click grab-app.vbs in this folder.' -ForegroundColor Gray
